resale_co.notes: The Building/Code Department page says a Certificate of Occupancy is required for all residential property sales and rentals. The Borough site does not publish a list of what the sale inspection covers, a lead time, or how long the certificate is valid. The sale application (created June 2026) asks whether the home will be rented (landlord registration required) and for bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, finished basement and attic counts. Rental certificates use a separate Certificate of New Rental form; the page says rental COs should have a lead inspection, and lists absentee landlord registration at $100.00 and lead paint abatement at $150.00. The Borough code on ecode360 was not opened (bot check).

fire_cert.notes: The NJ DCA registry lists the Haledon Fire Department as the fire code enforcing agency, but the Borough's Fire Prevention Bureau page says the Bureau enforces the fire code in all buildings except owner-occupied 1 and 2 family homes, and the state directory puts smoke detector compliance with the Haledon Borough Building Department. The Borough's sale application and fee list charge the smoke and carbon monoxide inspection through the Construction / Code Enforcement office, so that office is recorded as the issuer. Fee wording differs slightly: the 2026 sale form says a flat $85 additional fee; the Building page says $6.00 per alarm with an $85.00 minimum. No Borough list of local smoke or CO alarm extras was found. Fire Official names differ: the state directory (survey February 2025) lists Shawn Allen (Sallen@haledonboronj.com); the Borough Fire Prevention Bureau page lists Robert DeVirgilio as Fire Prevention Chief / Fire Safety Official.

other_items.detail: If the home will be rented, landlord registration is required (the sale form asks); absentee landlord registration is $100.00.
